[P4] Sierra Blanca (Andalusia)
Sierra Blanca is a mountain range of the Penibaetic System in Málaga Province , Andalusia , Spain . Its highest point is the 1,275 m high Pico del Lastonar . The Sierra Blanca , meaning ` White Range ' , is named after the lack of vegetation on its slopes which leaves the pale grey limestone rock exposed .
